# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 and modern hosts** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156 brings Skia m156, native GTK4 GPU views, and updated platform integrations. The preview line restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery, improves Android frame pacing, and fixes font, stream, and Windows view lifetimes. Review the Apple and Tizen minimums, Uno 7 migration, GTK4 coordinate changes, and stricter input checks before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS, or Mac Catalyst 15. Raise application deployment targets accordingly, retaining any higher managed-framework or application requirement. These final floors supersede the earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Catalyst 14 native baseline and support Xcode 27 builds; .NET 9 targets remain available. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Move Tizen consumers to Tizen 10** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp Tizen native packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and support x64 and arm64. Tizen 8/9 and the old 32-bit build paths are not supported. Retarget applications to .NET 10 and Tizen 10; source builders need the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **Migrate Uno views to Uno Platform 7** — Non-Windows Uno views require Uno 7 and .NET 10; legacy platform/runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell linking are retired. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, renders through a CPU canvas, reports null GRContext, and drops RaiseOnUnsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for Uno GPU rendering and Uno.Sdk's .NET SDK WebAssembly pipeline. Windows facades retain the ANGLE-backed WinUI control. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Choose GTK4 paint coordinates explicitly** — SKDrawingArea now allocates full-resolution backing pixels and reports physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info by default. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true to retain logical painting coordinates without losing backing resolution; RawInfo remains physical and GTK input coordinates remain logical. The new SKGLArea follows the same contract. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Pass well-formed encoded font buffers** — Encoded font operations now throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative byte lengths and ArgumentException for odd GlyphId byte counts before native interop. Supply nonnegative lengths and complete 16-bit glyph IDs to BreakText, glyph conversion/counting, measurement, and text-path operations. Encoded BreakText results count bytes; string and char-span results count UTF-16 code units. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))
- **Keep SKData copy lengths within the source array** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source array rather than relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Use one encoded unit for character-code conversion** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode now requires exactly one encoded unit rather than inferring validity from UTF-16 string length. Use Utf8 only for ASCII, Utf16 for BMP characters, and Utf32 for supplementary code points. Empty, multi-character, or multi-unit input throws ArgumentException; null byte arrays passed to GetString now throw ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Rebuild custom WebAssembly archives for WebGPU linking** — Newer WebAssembly consumers expect emdawnwebgpu C++ support inside libSkiaSharp.a rather than compiling it during the application link. Use matching rebuilt native assets; pre-change archives and GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy this contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU link path is retained, and JavaScript compiler glue remains a consumer-side link input. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Use a supported Windows host instead of the fork WinRT target** — The fork-specific native WinRT target is retired. Move applications relying on it to a supported Windows integration; desktop Windows, WinUI/Windows App SDK, and NanoServer remain supported. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 156** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m156. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.100 for this milestone while retaining the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine; the milestone update itself adds no managed bindings. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))
- **Upstream shader and rendering corrections** — Rejects overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types, contains failed shader pipelines, and fixes GLES BGRA uploads. Also corrects conic-region storage, Graphite stroke bounds and paint-key comparisons, glyph allocation bounds, and inverse-filled shapes outside the scissor. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517), [#5575](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5575))

## API Surface

- **Native GTK4 GPU canvas** — Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, a view-owned GRContext, CanvasSize, IgnorePixelScaling, and an opt-in render loop. GTK owns the GL context; use QueueRender to invalidate. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy, which supplies the GL dispatcher. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux font discovery and shaping coexistence** — Restores directory-backed system-font discovery in Linux.NoDependencies without adding fontconfig, using /usr/share/fonts/ unless overridden at native build time. Bundled Linux HarfBuzz calls now stay within their own implementation, preventing incompatible symbol mixing after GTK loads system HarfBuzz. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086), [#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Display-paced Android texture rendering** — Automatic continuous GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of swap throughput. Explicit render requests remain independent, rendering stays on the GL worker, and pause, resize, resume, and reattachment preserve progress; this is not a cap on every RequestRender call. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Correct native callback booleans** — Native callback booleans use one-byte values for Skia and four-byte hb_bool_t values for HarfBuzz, correcting Apple ARM64 interpreter return-width issues. Public managed delegates remain bool, and false-returning HarfBuzz glyph-name callbacks no longer copy a name buffer. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Release retained font, stream, and view resources** — DWriteCore custom-font data is released after the last dependent typeface clone is disposed. Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream drops its reference to a borrowed stream without disposing it; callers still own that stream. Windows EGL teardown unbinds its own current context so the native window and MAUI view can be collected. ([#5577](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5577), [#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327), [#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))
- **Native lifetime and platform handling corrected** — Retains the OpenGL module behind cached WGL pointers and corrects optional stream callbacks, XPS COM ownership, and browser capability handling. GTK4 raster surfaces are now disposed before their Cairo-owned pixel storage. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382), [#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Fewer temporary allocations** — Managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation for valid direct-copy buffers. HarfBuzzSharp pools AddUtf32 string encoding storage and uses a bounded stack buffer for feature formatting while preserving existing decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Framework-matched WebAssembly assets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now select Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for .NET 11 and later, including threading and SIMD variants. .NET 8 retains 3.1.34 and .NET 9/10 retain 3.1.56, avoiding mismatched native toolchains at application link time. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))
- **Updated Windows integration assets** — Refreshes WinUI ANGLE to chromium/8118 and library dependencies to Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003. Native asset selection recognizes portable win-x86, win-x64, and win-arm64 RIDs instead of legacy win10-* branches; explicit-platform and empty-RID selection remain available. The dependency refresh does not raise declared Windows runtime minimums. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

Reduces temporary allocations in AddUtf32 and feature formatting, and corrects font and Unicode callback boolean widths. Apple assets now require macOS 12 or iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 15, Tizen assets target .NET 10/Tizen 10, and .NET 11 WebAssembly selects Emscripten 6.0.2 archives; the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0.

## Release Candidate 1 (November 4, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 adds Android display-paced rendering, Uno 7 integration, WebGPU archive linking, and font, callback, and stream-lifetime fixes. It also brings upstream m156 corrections and raises Apple deployment minimums to macOS 12 and iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 15.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10...v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11)

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m156 and GTK4 GPU rendering with physical-pixel scaling, and restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery. It also aligns .NET 11 WebAssembly archives and moves Tizen packages to .NET 10 and Tizen 10.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.155.0...v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)
